LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: SPELLING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Writing
Topic 3.3: Guided Writing: Spelling

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Guided Writing: Spelling. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do you take care of school property?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. construct simple paragraphs with correct spelling for comprehension
2. appreciate the role of spelling in effective communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: GUIDED WRITING: SPELLING
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE · Grade: Grade 6
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Guided Writing: Spelling helps you succeed in ARABIC LANGUAGE. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: GUIDED WRITING: SPELLING
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Construct simple paragraphs with correct spelling for comprehension

What this means
In this part you learn to construct simple paragraphs with correct spelling for comprehension. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: construct simple paragraphs with correct spelling for comprehension.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Guided Writing: Spelling”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can construct simple paragraphs with correct spelling for comprehension. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate the role of spelling in effective communication

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the role of spelling in effective communication. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the role of spelling in effective communication.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Guided Writing: Spelling to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the role of spelling in effective communication. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Guided Writing: Spelling is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Guided Writing: Spelling”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: construct simple paragraphs with correct spelling for comprehension)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Guided Writing: Spelling to a partner. (skill: appreciate the role of spelling in effective communication)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Guided Writing: Spelling to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: construct simple paragraphs with correct spelling for comprehension.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate the role of spelling in effective communication.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Guided Writing: Spelling from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Guided Writing: Spelling: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 6 learner study Guided Writing: Spelling?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you take care of school property?
2. How does spelling affect meaning of words?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Guided Writing: Spelling means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: construct simple paragraphs with correct spelling for comprehension.
5. Be able to: appreciate the role of spelling in effective communication.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
